title: Homework: 9s Friday quiz and three two-step problems
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Multiplication and division (b); length and perimeter; fractions
source: Written for mathematics/y4 lesson 13 (TT: 9s Friday quiz; solve 3 two-step problems from the teacher's sheet.)
intro: Part A: the 9s quiz (aim for under 3 minutes). Part B: two-step problems: write both steps.

questions.q: A shop has 4 boxes of 9 apples. It sells 17 apples. How many apples are left?
You have £50. You buy 3 books at £9 each. How much change do you get?
There are 128 chairs in a hall. 56 are stacked away. The rest are put in rows of 9. How many rows are there?
